info.title: yolocam serve --stdio
info.description:
Controls the image settings of a YoloLiv YoloCam S3. Run `yolocam serve --stdio` once and keep it running. It holds the webcam's only settings connection, so don't run another yolocam or YoloLiv Compose at the same time.

Messages are JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdin and stdout, one per line. stderr is for humans. Params are by name. Requests are handled one at a time, so when driving a slider, keep at most one set per property in flight.

Exit codes: 0 stdin closed or SIGTERM, 2 bad command line, 3 webcam unreachable or connection lost, 4 another yolocam holds the webcam, 1 anything else.

Camera errors have code 1 and an error.data.kind to branch on: not_implemented, unsupported_value, camera_status, timeout or session_lost. Bad params have code -32602 and a kind of invalid_params, unknown_property or invalid_value.

After subscribe, the webcam's own messages arrive as push notifications. The only named one is tracking_rect_push (face tracking, only while focus_type is face), with one 0..1 rectangle per face. Ignore pushes you don't know.

methods.description: Writes the whole value. Members left out of an object value default: zoom center_x and center_y to 0.5 (factor is required), everything else to 0.

effective_when.description: Setting the property only changes the picture while this other property has this value. Not every property keeps a value set outside that mode, so set this other property first when the value must stick.
